CREATE TABLE topic (
  id                  TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  slug                TEXT NOT NULL,
  name                TEXT NOT NULL,
  description         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  status              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived')),
  current_version     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  revision            INTEGER NOT NULL,
  question_count      INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at          REAL NOT NULL,
  updated_at          REAL NOT NULL,
  archived_at         REAL,
  schedule_json       TEXT,
  schedule_updated_at REAL,
  questions_json      TEXT NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_topic_slug ON topic(slug)

CREATE TABLE topic_version (
  id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  topic_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
  version        INTEGER NOT NULL,
  questions_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  change_note    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at     REAL NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (topic_id, version)
)

CREATE TABLE entry (
  id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  topic_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
  version      INTEGER NOT NULL,
  revision     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  source       TEXT NOT NULL,
  channel      TEXT NOT NULL,
  captured_at  REAL NOT NULL,
  created_at   REAL NOT NULL,
  updated_at   REAL NOT NULL,
  notes        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  meta_json    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  answers_json TEXT NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_entry_topic ON entry(topic_id, captured_at)

CREATE TABLE tombstone (
  kind     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('entry', 'topic', 'version')),
  id       TEXT NOT NULL,
  topic_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  seq      INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY (kind, id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_tombstone_topic ON tombstone(topic_id)
